## Verdict

Kelp costs least for a team of 12, at $96 per month. It is the only vendor whose minimum (5 seats) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly the seats it uses. Acme Desk and Fennel HQ both bill for seats nobody will occupy.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $14 | 25 |
| Fennel HQ | $19 | 50 |
| Kelp | $8 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the larger of 12 and the vendor minimum.

- **Kelp:** minimum 5 is below 12, so 12 seats paid. 12 × $8 = **$96 per month**.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 25 exceeds 12, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $14 = **$350 per month**. Thirteen seats, worth $182, go unused.
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 50 exceeds 12, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $19 = **$950 per month**. Thirty-eight seats, worth $722, go unused.

Kelp is $254 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $854 cheaper than Fennel HQ — $3,048 and $10,248 over twelve months.

## Risks

Seat minimums, not per-seat rates, drive this result, so the ranking is specific to a 12-person team. Acme Desk's effective rate at 12 people is $29.17 per person ($350 ÷ 12), falling to its list $14 only at 25 seats; Kelp still costs less there ($200 against $350). Fennel HQ does not reach its list rate until 50 seats and is not price-competitive at any size in this range.

This covers price alone. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits or contract terms, so the cheapest seat may not be a comparable product.

All figures assume monthly billing as stated. Annual commitments, negotiated discounts and onboarding fees are not on the list and could change the ranking. Check whether minimums bind at signup or only at renewal.
